items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: I was still on the show with Groucho and everything.

ctx.x: Did you save any of those clips now? Do you have any of them?

Oh somewhere, yeah. But I’d have to sort of dig them out. You know when you save things, things are on top of other things, unless you can figure, well you can put it on the wall I guess. But anyway that was great. Les and everybody loved that album. And most of the jazz stations, it wasn’t like now, we’ve got about one jazz station. There were quite a few little small, different hours. They were all riding that album. They wouldn’t just play one track, they’d play the whole, one side. You know that was a big LP.…
Gee you’re one of the first jazz flute players. Where did you — did you hear anybody else doing it before you? © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
